freeze_invariants.evidence: Both persisted dispatchers reject SUBMIT_ENTRY before send-started; fixed venue-specific opening gates remain UNQUALIFIED. Offline order compilation and conditional/full-stop readback do not promote either gate.

Product chooses one default-data-root/control/selected-demo-writer.lock across venue, account, credential reference and selected data root. Credential retrieval follows lease acquisition; epoch and journal checks fence effects. Native task and reconciliation worker must finish before lease release.

freeze_invariants.invariant: Unknown sends, lost acknowledgements and duplicate IDs never authorize resend or reservation release
freeze_invariants.evidence: Send-started persists UNKNOWN before an effect; attempted sends reject subsequent dispatch. Native statuses/fills and bounded history append evidence only. Current flat observation carries can_release_reservation=false.

freeze_invariants.invariant: Exact venue, environment, account and instrument evidence
freeze_invariants.evidence: Bybit current profile receipts require the selected identity and exact endpoints. Binance native fill/status persistence requires a matching durable account identity, product reference and symbol. Binance REST trades and order statuses require the selected durable account identity before evidence writes; all trades in a batch validate before its first write. Independent adversarial cases passed in the fresh runtime suite.

freeze_invariants.invariant: Authenticated read port remains GET-only and does not expose credentials
freeze_invariants.evidence: Readers allowlist paths, use GET, bound payload/time, disable ambient proxy handlers and redirects, and reject credential echoes with fixed error codes. Credential repr is protected; demo child stdout/stderr are discarded; selected status contains no credential bytes.

freeze_invariants.invariant: Capital and assisted execution remain false
freeze_invariants.evidence: Run manifest validation requires both flags false. Selected qualification and product active/stopped status retain both false. Public startup does not launch authenticated demo OMS.

findings.title: Bybit current account qualification omitted receipt identity and endpoint checks
findings.impact: Foreign fresh account info/wallet receipts could be relabeled under the selected reader identity and qualify a reduction profile.

findings.title: Binance native fill association omitted durable account and product scope checks
findings.impact: Matching symbol/client IDs could associate current native fill/status evidence to an intent whose durable command identity or instrument reference belongs to a foreign scope.

findings.title: Binance REST fill association omitted durable account identity checks
findings.impact: The trade helper accepted a selected account identity while its associated durable command identity belonged to another account; matching client and symbol alone permitted an evidence write.

independent_review_cases.scope: Included in the same fresh full runtime run.

qualification_limits: No credential was retrieved from a real store, and no authenticated external venue call or node connection was performed.
Synthetic fixtures and source review do not qualify fill-time protection equivalence or live/capital operation.
The selected writer lease fences one local installation/user location; cross-host credential use requires separate venue/credential fencing.
Bybit profile qualification explicitly reports UNVERIFIED_ACCOUNT_IDENTITY: its fingerprint binds declared scope and credential, not a stable broker UID.
Credential redaction checks cover application-owned boundaries; third-party SDK internals, Windows DPAPI/ACL behavior and native authenticated connection logs were not exercised.
This artifact binds reviewed file bytes and test evidence hashes; it does not certify a final integrated commit SHA.

execution_authority.qualification: Source inspection and synthetic offline fixtures only; no live or capital authority is granted.
